name: Dual VC Dimension / Minimum Degree (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the universal class $\mathcal U_n$, $\mathrm{VC}^*=n$, while its one-inclusion graph is edgeless and $\mathrm d_{\min}=0$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, $\mathrm d_{\min}=n$, whereas $\mathrm{VC}^*=\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$.
proof: The universal-class and full-cube calculations give unbounded gaps in the two opposite directions.
